channelTitle: The inventor asked for 'just rice' - the whole court laughed - Part 1
hook: A wise man asked an emperor for 'just some rice' - and the whole court laughed at his humble request.
storyParts: Long ago, legend says, a clever inventor presented the emperor with a new game: sixty-four squares, tiny carved armies, endless strategy. The emperor was so delighted he offered any reward the man could name.
The inventor bowed low and asked for something humble. One grain of rice on the first square. Two on the second. Four on the third. Keep doubling, he said, until the board is full.
The court burst out laughing. Rice! When he could have asked for gold, land, a palace! Ministers whispered that the inventor must have gone mad in his old age.
The emperor signed the decree at once, proud of his own generosity and a little smug about the fool's modest price. The treasurers were ordered to start counting the squares that very afternoon.
They began stacking: one grain, two, four, eight. By the tenth square it filled a bowl. By the fifteenth, a basket. And then a treasurer raised his hand, and asked the emperor to come see something.
